elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly states that the Company has “no exclusivity or sole-provider obligation to HDI.”

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The clause eliminates exclusivity rather than establishing category-limited exclusivity.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no 12-month exclusivity period or other exclusivity duration.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no automatic termination trigger based on HDI’s failure to meet service levels.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no automatic termination trigger based on HDI’s failure to meet delivery dates.
